description:
• About our brand and products: 

Semikolon is a German lifestyle stationery and home organization brand inspired by thoughtful living, timeless design, and everyday creativity. We create beautifully crafted products that bring calm, color, and intention into daily life — from photo albums and keepsake storage to desk accessories and memory-keeping essentials. Our bestselling collections include our iconic Photo Albums, the versatile 4RoomBox storage system, and our Wedding Collection featuring coordinated photo albums, guest books, and keepsake boxes designed for meaningful moments. For customers looking for a more affordable and flexible option, our Spiral Photo Album is a favorite for casual memory keeping and gifting.


• What makes us different: 

Semikolon combines premium design with emotional storytelling. Our products are designed not only to organize life beautifully, but to help people preserve memories, celebrate creativity, and create inspiring spaces at home. With vibrant colors, minimalist aesthetics, and high-quality craftsmanship, Semikolon naturally fits into lifestyle, home decor, journaling, gifting, and creative content.


• How affiliates can earn:

We are looking for lifestyle, aesthetic, creative living, journaling, home decor, wedding, and memory-keeping creators to join the Semikolon Creator Community. Approved creators will receive a personalized affiliate link to share with their audience and earn commission on qualified sales. We are especially excited to build long-term ambassador relationships with creators whose visual style aligns with the Semikolon brand.


• How to promote us: 

Creators can feature Semikolon through lifestyle content such as desk setups, home styling, journaling routines, memory keeping, wedding inspiration, gifting guides, creative organization, and everyday aesthetic moments across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, blogs, and other social platforms.


• Other information: 

We value authentic storytelling, beautiful visual content, and long-term collaboration over one-time promotion. Selected creators may also receive opportunities for product gifting, seasonal campaigns, featured collaborations, and early access to new collections.
